q1.question: Do you replace our category health fund (e.g. Fondo EST, Metasalute, Unisalute)?
q1.answer: No, we make the most of it. We don't replace the CCNL fund your company already pays for by law. On the contrary, we give employees an intuitive platform that guides them step by step to use 100% of the benefits they already have, turning a mandatory cost into a benefit that is genuinely perceived and used.

q2.question: How does extra coverage work alongside the existing fund?
q2.answer: In perfect synergy and without overlaps. We identify the services excluded or uncovered by your category fund and add only the complementary policies that are actually needed. For the employee the experience is completely seamless: one platform, one Advisor, as if there were a single large policy.

q3.question: How do you cost less than a traditional health policy?
q3.answer: By removing waste. Traditional policies (often over €700 per year per employee) make you pay again for services your CCNL fund would already cover. HeyLucy first guides the employee to use the existing coverage and adds complementary protection only where it is really needed, delivering complete protection from just ~€250 a year.

q4.question: How does the human Health Consultant work and when does it step in?
q4.answer: It is a support team dedicated to the most complex and convoluted cases. It steps in when bureaucracy risks blocking the employee: for example when a facility asks for a payment for a service that should be covered, or when the insurance wording is impenetrable. The consultant takes ownership of the problem and guides the person step by step to a solution.

q5.question: How does the Prevention Area inside the platform work?
q5.answer: It is the section where all the prevention covered by the fund is mapped out. The app flags the free check-ups and tests available to the employee and links straight to the booking process. The platform tells you when it's time for a screening and walks you through how to use it without making mistakes.

platform.title: How the platform works
platform.subtitle: Four tools. Below you will find what each one does, explained in plain words.

card1.title: Smart coverage search
card1.lead: Ask your question the way you would ask a colleague and get an answer in seconds.
card1.body: Your health fund rulebook runs to dozens of pages and nobody reads it. On the platform you type a normal question, for example “how much do I get back for a dental cleaning”. The system searches your fund's official documents and answers in plain language.
card1.point1: Ask in your own words, no technical terms needed
card1.point2: The answer arrives in seconds, not in two days
card1.point3: Every answer points to the official document it came from, so you can check it

card2.title: Human Health Advisor
card2.lead: When the paperwork gets stuck, a real person answers you.
card2.body: The platform handles the simple questions. For complicated cases there is a real person. You need one when a clinic asks you to pay for something the fund should cover, or when the form makes no sense. You write, one of our people takes the problem on and stays with you until it is solved.
card2.point1: Write on WhatsApp, nothing to install
card2.point2: A person replies, not an automated message
card2.point3: They stay with you to the solution instead of passing you to another desk

card3.title: Prevention tracking
card3.lead: See on one screen which free check-ups you still have this year.
card3.body: Your fund already pays for some prevention tests every year. If you do not book them by December you lose them, and most people do lose them because they never knew they had them. The platform shows the list of check-ups you are entitled to, marks which ones you have done and reminds you when it is time to book the next one.
card3.point1: The list of check-ups in your fund is ready, you do not have to hunt for it
card3.point2: See at a glance what you have done and what is missing
card3.point3: Get a reminder before the year runs out

card4.title: Exclusive partnerships and discounts
card4.lead: If the fund does not cover everything, you still pay less.
card4.body: Some services are only partly covered by the fund, others not at all. For those we have direct agreements with clinics and specialists at reduced prices. You book from the platform and the discount is already applied to the price you see.
card4.point1: Reduced prices on specialist visits and diagnostic tests
card4.point2: The discount is already applied, you do not have to ask anyone
card4.point3: It also covers nutritionists and services the fund does not pay for
